scope: Current-state evidence retention audit after substantial earlier cleanup.
decision: No bulk deletion justified. Retain all source data, promoted/referenced evidence, active dependencies, and unknown replay outputs until deletion proof exists.
protected_rules: All source/raw recordings are protected by default.
Promoted evidence and evidence referenced by reviewed result documents are protected.
Frozen experiment inputs and active roadmap dependencies are protected.
Unknown provenance or uncertain dependency status means retain.
Historical detector/model provenance must not be rewritten.
Held-out data and outcomes are outside Issue #49 cleanup scope.
deletion_gate: Search tracked docs, reports, scripts, catalogues, annotations, aliases, and GitHub evidence.
Verify no promoted result or active roadmap dependency requires the path.
Verify a canonical replacement with adequate provenance when replacement is claimed.
Record the deletion in a tracked machine-readable manifest before or with the deletion.

repetition_policy.default: Retain the canonical/reviewed run and only the repetitions required by the promoted methodology or acceptance evidence.
repetition_policy.extra_repetitions: May be deleted only after their non-dependence and canonical replacement are proven.

smoke_failed_policy.default: Names such as smoke, pilot, failed, incomplete, visual, tmp, or UI do not by themselves authorize deletion.
smoke_failed_policy.delete_when: The output is generated, unreferenced, diagnostically unnecessary, reproducible from protected inputs, and its removal is recorded.

annotation_discovery.current_workflow: Use real source/replay paths, resolving reference aliases where useful, plus UI role grouping and favourites.
